patches.name: FF7EC network shim
patches.description: Installs the FF7 Ever Crisis preservation shim: optional TLS-verification bypass, decrypted on-device traffic logging, and an optional DNS redirect.

patches.name: FF7EC network shim (files)
patches.description: Bundles the native preservation shim and its configuration into the APK.

options.title: Disable TLS certificate verification
options.description: Lets the client accept any TLS certificate, so preservation traffic capture works without a trusted cert on this device.

options.title: Log decrypted traffic
options.description: Writes decrypted gRPC request/response bodies under the app's own external-files folder: Android/data/com.square_enix.android_googleplay.ff7ecww/files/ff7ec_logs/ (no storage permission needed - it's the app's own directory).

options.title: Redirect DNS lookups
options.description: Redirects the game's own hostname lookups to the Redirect IP below. Off by default: traffic logging works without it, since it reads the game's own already-decrypted buffers rather than intercepting the connection.

options.title: Redirect IP
options.description: Only used when 'Redirect DNS lookups' is enabled above.
